launches.title: Upstream - The first inbox designed for humans and agents
launches.tagline: Your inbox, handled for you. Agents sort the noise, draft replies in your voice, and follow up automatically.
launches.body:
Hey YC! 👋

We’re [Louis Lecat](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lecatlouis/) and [Jonathan Tiret](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jtiret/) - co-founders of Upstream.

**TL;DR**: Upstream is an email client that handles your inbox for you. Agents sort the noise, draft in your exact voice, follow up on time, and do what you ask, so you can finally relax and enjoy email again.

<https://youtu.be/bJJ9aCIGmyw> 

Try it here: [Sign up with Google](https://www.upstream.do/?utm_source=launch_yc&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch&utm_content=announcement)

# The problem

We were told AI was going to fix email. Two years in, your inbox looks the same, the drafts sound like ChatGPT, and you stopped clicking on the AI buttons bolted on every product. We wanted an inbox where agents work for you - before you ask - but still let you make the final call.

# What we built

We rebuilt email from the ground up as a surface agents can read, write, and act on.

**📥 Your inbox is organized**

Spam, cold outreach, and low-priority emails are moved out of the way. The conversations that actually need your attention stay front and center.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103613&key=user_uploads/1093527/c1514848-21d2-48c7-b346-743016d125a1)

**✍️ Custom voice prompt**

Upstream learns how you write from your own emails and drafts replies that sound exactly like you, adapting to who you’re talking to.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103613&key=user_uploads/1093527/33e44baf-2ff7-4291-87e8-10b9d9beabf8)

**🤖 Built-in agent to do what you ask**

Find receipts, write personalized emails, schedule meetings, update records, or handle whatever task comes up in your inbox.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103613&key=user_uploads/1093527/b782c513-24c0-4c02-8be9-37d3ef4f777f)

**⏰ Smart follow-ups**

When someone drops the ball, Upstream follows up automatically at the right time so important conversations keep moving.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103613&key=user_uploads/1093527/ebd46d18-6369-48c7-91e2-cb8e6f2a3ce9)

# Open and agent-native

Email is becoming a shared workspace for humans and agents. Upstream is built for both.

**🧠 Uses your company context**

Connect Granola, Notion, Google Drive, and Calendar so agents understand your work before they act.

**🔌 Use it from Claude or Codex**

Control Upstream over MCP from Claude, Codex, or your own agents. Or bring agents directly into Upstream.

Finally, we made every system prompt fully editable, so that you can configure it to work the way you want.

# What users told us

During our closed beta, customers told us they felt more in control of their inbox, and that email had become a fun part of their day again. We’ve seen many people replace Superhuman with Upstream’s free plan.

# Our Ask

Try Upstream and let us know what you think. Setup is fully automated and only takes a few minutes - and it’s free!

Link to get started: [upstream.do](http://upstream.do)

Thank you!

launches.title: ⚡ Upstream || 📥 An email client designed for team collaboration
launches.tagline: Delivering efficiency for teams, while letting individuals regain focus.
launches.body:
### **📝 TL;DR**

> **Upstream is a modern email client designed for team collaboration. Teams use it to have conversations that are easy to track, rich in context, and transparent with the rest of their company.**

Sign up for the waitlist at [**www.upstream.do**](https://www.upstream.do/?utm_source=yc_launch&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch) !

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73531&key=user_uploads/1303398/125f0ac3-f789-46b8-8e2d-1b714e67518b)

### **📖 Our Story**

I’ve had the chance to work at successful fast-growing companies, like **Asana** and **Algolia**, and I’ve experienced first-hand the communication problems that arise when you need to coordinate with lots of people while moving at 100mph.

All organizations are very nimble in the early days, yet most of them lose their efficiency as they scale. **Communication becomes harder**, and teamwork breaks down. Companies continue to rely on **Slack for anything and everything** and start experiencing major inefficiencies:

* **The ball keeps getting dropped:** important messages get missed. Key action items are buried in the never-ending flow of chit-chat.
* **Decisions and their context get lost in the ether:** where did we discuss this again? Who was involved? What decision did we make and why?
* **Team members waste their time reading irrelevant discussions** rather than getting stuff done, Slack making it impossible to distinguish signal from noise.
* **We’re constantly interrupted:** chat’s expectation of immediacy has made it nearly impossible to find uninterrupted deep work time.

And while it’s a huge productivity loss for the organization, employees report experiencing deep **anxiety** and feeling completely **overwhelmed** by the use of Slack.

### **💡 A different tool for async conversations**

When I was at Asana, we did things differently: we had a specific tool for all of our async conversations (I’m sure you’ve guessed: we used asana for that!). It made it so that our **decisions were easily traceable**, our important conversations had the right amount of context and the right folks involved, action items never got lost, and the volume of Slack notifications was totally reasonable.

It was so good! I could **easily focus and get in flow**, and always felt on the same page with the teams around me. We were firing on all cylinders! It was pure bliss.

It left such a strong impression on me that ever since I left Asana, I haven’t stopped thinking about how to **bring that experience to other teams out there**. And when I started seriously researching this, it became clear that, except for a handful of exceptional companies (think Stripe, Gitlab, Alan to name a few), 99% of them don’t even know they could work this way.

I’ve since met [**@Jonathan Tiret**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jtiret/), and here we are with Upstream: an easy way for teams to make, track and share decisions, directly within their emails.

### **💻 Solution: elevating your emails**

> **_Upstream is an email client that lets teams have conversations that are easy to track, rich in context, and transparent with the rest of their company._**

We don’t need to fully replace Slack. Chat is great for social chit-chat. Or when you need an answer right away. But more than 80% of our messages don’t require an immediate response. Upstream is a better place to **handle these messages async**:

* Conversations have **context** on who needs to do what by when (assignees, due dates, statuses, summaries, etc.)
* Team members can stay on top of incoming messages in a nice and tidy **inbox**
* Conversations are made **visible** to the team, yet people stay opted out of notifications by default

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73531&key=user_uploads/1303398/5805682f-8b48-4622-8002-85cf63977990)

Because let’s be honest: **you don’t need one more inbox**. We're building Upstream to simply work with your existing email address: manage everything in one place, create alignment with your team, and regain time for productive work.

### **🤝 Who we are**

I ([**@Louis Lecat**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lecatlouis/)) was one of the early product people at [**@Asana**](https://asana.com/), where I honed my craft in building engaging collaboration software. I went on to lead the entire product team at [**@Algolia**](https://www.algolia.com/) as their Head of Product through series B and C, assembling a team of 20+ talented Designers, PMs, and Researchers, while growing ARR 2.5x to $100M+.

[**@Jonathan Tiret**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jtiret/) has extensive experience as a hands-on engineer and a tech leader in SaaS. He was the VP of Engineering at [**@Doctrine**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/doctrine/) before it got acquired, and is the creator of [**@Dino Gaïa**](https://www.dinogaia.com/)**,** one of the most popular online consumer games in France in the 2000s.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73531&key=user_uploads/1303398/6f46c6e2-66dd-4a9f-a0b0-43045858c643)

**_We’re on a mission to make the other 99% of companies out there more efficient and productive and we’re obsessed about it!_**

* [**Sign up**](https://www.upstream.do/?utm_source=yc_launch&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch) for the waitlist
* [**Book a call**](https://calendly.com/upstream-louis/intro) with us if these problems truly resonate with you. We’re looking for design partners to onboard onto the alpha version of the product, and help us shape its future.
